# Should I Propose Copperline Phase 3

Should I propose a third phase to Copperline for 2027, and what should be in it?

## For

- Renata Solberg has hinted at card controls and alerts; Gideon Marsh wants sign-in reviewed against accessible authentication ([[wcag-accessible-authentication-minimum-docs]]); Priyanka Venkat wants her team trained in research.
- Continuity: I know the system, the people and the data quirks. Copperline would pay for that.
- Card controls and alerts were option C in phase 2 ($88,000 for the whole), so there is a price anchor ([[copperline-statement-of-work]]).

## Against

- Copperline is about 70% of my 2026 client income. Another year like that makes the business fragile ([[how-many-engagements-can-i-run-at-once]]).
- A large phase 3 would block the kind of small engagements that bring new clients and case studies.

## Leaning

Propose a smaller phase 3 as three options under the [[proposal-template-rework]] format: a paid research training for Priyanka's team plus sign-in review (small), plus card controls (middle), plus alerts (large). Cap my time at three days a week. Decide by mid-November so the proposal lands before Copperline's budget round in December.
